// Variáveis de Estado do Áudio
static bool audio_enabled = false;
static int current_volume = 60;
static RingbufHandle_t audio_ringbuf = NULL;
static TaskHandle_t audio_task_handle = NULL;

// Botões de volume da tela
static lv_obj_t *btn_vol_up = NULL;
static lv_obj_t *btn_vol_down = NULL;

// 1. Envolver a API da APU em extern "C" pois é um header C puro
// e declarar os interceptadores ANTES do walnut_cgb.h
extern "C" {
    #include "minigb_apu.h"

    uint8_t audio_read(uint16_t addr);
    void audio_write(uint16_t addr, uint8_t val);
}

#include "walnut_cgb.h"

static const char *TAG = "GbcEmu";

// ---------------------------------------------------------
// VARIÁVEIS GLOBAIS DE ALTA PERFORMANCE
// ---------------------------------------------------------
static uint8_t* emu_rom_buffer = nullptr;
static uint8_t* emu_cart_ram = nullptr;
static uint16_t* display_fb = nullptr;

static volatile bool frame_is_ready = false;
static uint32_t quadros_logicos = 0;
static uint32_t quadros_visuais = 0;

// Paleta padrão para jogos antigos (DMG)
const uint16_t dmg_pal[4] = {0xFFFF, 0xAD55, 0x52AA, 0x0000};

// PRE-DECLARAÇÃO DOS CALLBACKS
static uint8_t gb_rom_read(struct gb_s* gb, const uint_fast32_t addr);
static uint16_t gb_rom_read16(struct gb_s* gb, const uint_fast32_t addr);
static uint32_t gb_rom_read32(struct gb_s* gb, const uint_fast32_t addr);
static uint8_t gb_cart_ram_read(struct gb_s* gb, const uint_fast32_t addr);
static void gb_cart_ram_write(struct gb_s* gb, const uint_fast32_t addr, const uint8_t val);
static void gb_error(struct gb_s* gb, const enum gb_error_e err, const uint16_t addr);

// ---------------------------------------------------------
// IMPLEMENTAÇÃO DOS CALLBACKS DE ÁUDIO
// ---------------------------------------------------------
extern "C" {
    uint8_t audio_read(uint16_t addr) {
        if (!audio_enabled) return 0xFF; 
        return minigb_audio_read(addr);
    }
    
    void audio_write(uint16_t addr, uint8_t val) {
        if (!audio_enabled) return;
        minigb_audio_write(addr, val);
    }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------
// IMPLEMENTAÇÃO DOS CALLBACKS DE MEMÓRIA DO GAME BOY
// ---------------------------------------------------------
static uint8_t IRAM_ATTR gb_rom_read(struct gb_s* gb, const uint_fast32_t addr) { return emu_rom_buffer[addr]; }
static uint16_t IRAM_ATTR gb_rom_read16(struct gb_s* gb, const uint_fast32_t addr) { uint16_t val; memcpy(&val, emu_rom_buffer + addr, 2); return val; }
static uint32_t IRAM_ATTR gb_rom_read32(struct gb_s* gb, const uint_fast32_t addr) { uint32_t val; memcpy(&val, emu_rom_buffer + addr, 4); return val; }
static uint8_t IRAM_ATTR gb_cart_ram_read(struct gb_s* gb, const uint_fast32_t addr) { return emu_cart_ram ? emu_cart_ram[addr] : 0xFF; }
static void IRAM_ATTR gb_cart_ram_write(struct gb_s* gb, const uint_fast32_t addr, const uint8_t val) { if (emu_cart_ram) emu_cart_ram[addr] = val; }
static void IRAM_ATTR gb_error(struct gb_s* gb, const enum gb_error_e err, const uint16_t addr) {}

static void audio_drain_task(void *arg) {
    size_t bytes_written;
    while (GbcEmulator::get_instance().is_running() && audio_enabled) {
        size_t item_size;
        
        // Bloqueia a task até chegarem novos samples de áudio do emulador
        uint8_t *data = (uint8_t *)xRingbufferReceive(audio_ringbuf, &item_size, pdMS_TO_TICKS(100));
        
        if (data) {
            // Escoa os dados para o hardware de áudio
            bsp_extra_i2s_write(data, item_size, &bytes_written, portMAX_DELAY);
            vRingbufferReturnItem(audio_ringbuf, (void *)data);
        }
    }
    vTaskDelete(NULL);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------
// RENDERIZAÇÃO OTIMIZADA DE 32-BITS
// ---------------------------------------------------------
static void lcd_draw_line(struct gb_s *gb, const uint8_t *pixels, const uint_fast8_t line) {
    if (line >= 144 || display_fb == nullptr) return;

    // Otimização: A tela é 320x288 (Escala 2x do 160x144 original).
    // Para não escrever o mesmo pixel duas vezes separadamente na PSRAM,
    // empacotamos as duas cores de 16 bits em um inteiro de 32 bits.
    // Isso reduz pela METADE os ciclos de gravação na memória.
    uint32_t *row1 = (uint32_t*)display_fb + ((line * 2) * 160);
    uint32_t *row2 = (uint32_t*)display_fb + (((line * 2) + 1) * 160);

    for (int x = 0; x < 160; x++) {
        uint16_t color = gb->cgb.cgbMode ? gb->cgb.fixPalette[pixels[x]] : dmg_pal[pixels[x] & 3];
        
        // Empacota o pixel (16 bits esquerda, 16 bits direita)
        uint32_t color32 = (color << 16) | color; 
        row1[x] = color32;
        row2[x] = color32;
    }

    if (line == 143) {
        frame_is_ready = true;
    }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------
// CLASSE DO EMULADOR E CONTROLE DE HARDWARE
// ---------------------------------------------------------
static void set_cpu_freq(uint16_t mhz) {
    rtc_cpu_freq_config_t freq_config;
    rtc_clk_cpu_freq_mhz_to_config(mhz, &freq_config);
    rtc_clk_cpu_freq_set_config(&freq_config);
    ESP_LOGI(TAG, "CPU Clock alterado para %d MHz", mhz);
}

void GbcEmulator::start(const char* path) {
    if (running) return;
    
    set_cpu_freq(240);
    strncpy(current_rom_path, path, sizeof(current_rom_path));
    
    FILE* f = fopen(path, "rb");
    if (!f) return;
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);
    size_t rom_size = ftell(f);
    rewind(f);
    
    // A ROM (JOGO) TEM QUE IR PRA PSRAM EXTERNA (Salva RAM Interna)
    rom_buffer = (uint8_t*)heap_caps_malloc(rom_size, MALLOC_CAP_SPIRAM);
    if (!rom_buffer) { ESP_LOGE(TAG, "Falha ao alocar ROM na PSRAM"); fclose(f); return; }
    fread(rom_buffer, 1, rom_size, f);
    fclose(f);
    
    emu_rom_buffer = rom_buffer;

    // O CÉREBRO (CPU/WRAM) TEM PRIORIDADE NA RAM INTERNA
    gb_ctx = (struct gb_s*)heap_caps_calloc(1, sizeof(struct gb_s), MALLOC_CAP_INTERNAL | MALLOC_CAP_8BIT);
    if (!gb_ctx) gb_ctx = (struct gb_s*)heap_caps_calloc(1, sizeof(struct gb_s), MALLOC_CAP_SPIRAM);

    gb_init(gb_ctx, gb_rom_read, gb_rom_read16, gb_rom_read32, 
            gb_cart_ram_read, gb_cart_ram_write, gb_error, NULL);

    gb_get_save_size_s(gb_ctx, &cart_ram_size);
    if (cart_ram_size > 0) {
        cart_ram = (uint8_t*)heap_caps_calloc(1, cart_ram_size, MALLOC_CAP_SPIRAM);
        char sav_path[256];
        snprintf(sav_path, sizeof(sav_path), "%s", path);
        char *ext = strrchr(sav_path, '.');
        if (ext) strcpy(ext, ".sav");
        FILE* fsav = fopen(sav_path, "rb");
        if (fsav) { fread(cart_ram, 1, cart_ram_size, fsav); fclose(fsav); }
        emu_cart_ram = cart_ram;
    }
    
    gb_init_lcd(gb_ctx, lcd_draw_line);

    // Habilita o frame skip nativo do Walnut/Peanut-GB
    gb_ctx->direct.frame_skip = 1;
    
    // O VÍDEO FICA NA PSRAM
    if(!display_fb) {
        display_fb = (uint16_t*)heap_caps_malloc(320 * 288 * 2, MALLOC_CAP_SPIRAM);
    }
    if (display_fb) {
        memset(display_fb, 0, 320 * 288 * 2);
    }

    running = true;

    if (audio_enabled) {
        audio_init(); // Inicia os registradores virtuais do minigb_apu
        
        // Inicializa o hardware físico de áudio antes de usar
        bsp_extra_codec_init();

        // Cria um RingBuffer de 8KB na RAM interna para não competir com a PSRAM
        audio_ringbuf = xRingbufferCreate(8192, RINGBUF_TYPE_BYTEBUF);
        
        // Acorda o Codec I2S do BSP
        bsp_extra_codec_set_fs(44100, 16, I2S_SLOT_MODE_STEREO);
        bsp_extra_codec_mute_set(false);
        bsp_extra_codec_volume_set(current_volume, NULL);
        
        // Fixa a task de escoamento no Core 0 (Longe do vídeo e do motor Z80)
        xTaskCreatePinnedToCore(audio_drain_task, "audio_drain", 4096, NULL, 5, &audio_task_handle, 0);
    }
    
    // Inicia APENAS a emu_task (Input e Video fundidos)
    xTaskCreatePinnedToCore(emulator_task, "emu_task", 8192, NULL, 5, &emu_task_handle, 1);
}

void GbcEmulator::stop() {
    if (!running) return;
    running = false;
    vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(100));

    if (audio_ringbuf) {
        vRingbufferDelete(audio_ringbuf);
        audio_ringbuf = NULL;
    }
    
    if (cart_ram_size > 0 && cart_ram != nullptr) {
        char sav_path[256];
        snprintf(sav_path, sizeof(sav_path), "%s", current_rom_path);
        char *ext = strrchr(sav_path, '.');
        if (ext) strcpy(ext, ".sav");
        FILE* fsav = fopen(sav_path, "wb");
        if (fsav) { fwrite(cart_ram, 1, cart_ram_size, fsav); fclose(fsav); }
    }
    
    set_cpu_freq(160);
    esp_restart();
}

void GbcEmulator::save_game() {
    if (cart_ram_size > 0 && cart_ram != nullptr) {
        char sav_path[256];
        snprintf(sav_path, sizeof(sav_path), "%s", current_rom_path);
        
        // Troca a extensão .gb ou .gbc para .sav
        char *ext = strrchr(sav_path, '.');
        if (ext) strcpy(ext, ".sav");
        
        FILE* fsav = fopen(sav_path, "wb");
        if (fsav) { 
            fwrite(cart_ram, 1, cart_ram_size, fsav); 
            fclose(fsav); 
            ESP_LOGW(TAG, "Jogo salvo automaticamente (Auto-Save) antes do desligamento!");
        }
    }
}

void GbcEmulator::emulator_task(void* arg) {
    quadros_logicos = 0;
    quadros_visuais = 0;
    uint32_t last_fps_tick = xthal_get_ccount();
    
    while (GbcEmulator::get_instance().is_running()) {
        // Marca o tempo exato (em microssegundos) do início do frame
        uint64_t frame_start_us = esp_timer_get_time();
        
        // Botão físico de emergência
        if (gpio_get_level(GPIO_NUM_0) == 0) {
            GbcEmulator::get_instance().stop();
            break;
        }

        uint8_t keys = 0xFF;
        
        // 1. LEITURA DE INPUT DO LVGL (Protegido por Mutex)
        if (lvgl_port_lock(0)) {
            lv_indev_t * indev = lv_indev_get_next(NULL);
            if (indev && lv_indev_get_state(indev) == LV_INDEV_STATE_PRESSED) {
                lv_point_t p;
                lv_indev_get_point(indev, &p);
                int32_t tx = p.x;
                int32_t ty = p.y;

                // Sair (X) - Área ampliada para facilitar o clique com o dedo
                if (tx >= 60 && tx <= 130 && ty <= 60) {
                    lvgl_port_unlock();
                    GbcEmulator::get_instance().stop();
                    break;
                }

                // Canto Direito: Controle de Volume (Ignora inputs do Gameboy)
                if (audio_enabled && tx > 350 && ty > 80 && ty < 230) {
                }
                
                // ZONA ESQUERDA: D-Pad
                if (tx < 150 && ty > 250) {
                    int center_x = 72;  
                    int center_y = 402; 
                    
                    // Lógica independente permite apertar diagonal (ex: Cima + Esquerda)
                    if (tx < center_x - 22) keys &= ~JOYPAD_LEFT;
                    else if (tx > center_x + 22) keys &= ~JOYPAD_RIGHT;
                    
                    if (ty < center_y - 22) keys &= ~JOYPAD_UP;
                    else if (ty > center_y + 22) keys &= ~JOYPAD_DOWN;
                }
                // ZONA DIREITA: Botões A e B
                else if (tx > 220 && ty > 250) {
                    if (tx > 310) keys &= ~JOYPAD_A; 
                    else keys &= ~JOYPAD_B;
                }
                // ZONA CENTRAL: Start e Select
                else if (tx >= 150 && tx <= 220 && ty > 400) {
                    // O meio exato entre os dois botões agora fica no pixel 455
                    if (ty < 455) keys &= ~JOYPAD_START; // Se tocar da metade pra cima, é Start
                    else keys &= ~JOYPAD_SELECT;         // Da metade pra baixo, é Select
                }
            }
            lvgl_port_unlock();
        }
        
        GbcEmulator::get_instance().gb_ctx->direct.joypad = keys;

        // Execução do Core Gameboy
        quadros_logicos++;
        // Não calculamos mais o skip manualmente, o gb_run_frame faz isso!
        
        gb_run_frame(GbcEmulator::get_instance().gb_ctx);
        
        // --- INJEÇÃO DE ÁUDIO NO RINGBUFFER ---
        if (audio_enabled) {
            // Usa a macro oficial da APU para definir o tamanho exato requisitado
            const int req_sz = AUDIO_SAMPLES * 2 * sizeof(int16_t);
            static uint8_t sample_buffer[4096]; // Buffer generoso (4KB) blindado contra stack overflow
            
            // Puxa o áudio processado pela minigb_apu
            audio_callback(NULL, sample_buffer, req_sz);
            
            // Atira no RingBuffer com timeout curtíssimo (2ms) 
            // para jamais engasgar o vídeo se o I2S estiver lento
            if (audio_ringbuf) {
                xRingbufferSend(audio_ringbuf, sample_buffer, req_sz, pdMS_TO_TICKS(2));
            }
        }

        // A MÁGICA FINAL DA RENDERIZAÇÃO
        if (frame_is_ready) {
            frame_is_ready = false; // Reseta a flag para o próximo quadro
            quadros_visuais++;
            
            // Garantimos que o LVGL não vai mexer no display (desenhar os botões) 
            // enquanto estamos injetando o jogo
            if (lvgl_port_lock(pdMS_TO_TICKS(10))) {
                
                lv_display_t * disp = lv_display_get_default();
                if (disp && disp->flush_cb && display_fb) {
                    
                    const int TARGET_WIDTH  = 320;
                    const int TARGET_HEIGHT = 288;
                    const int OFFSET_X = 45;
                    const int OFFSET_Y = 15;
                    
                    int chunk_lines = 36;
                    int total_chunks = TARGET_HEIGHT / chunk_lines;

                    for (int i = 0; i < total_chunks; i++) {
                        lv_area_t area;
                        area.x1 = OFFSET_X;
                        area.y1 = OFFSET_Y + (i * chunk_lines);
                        area.x2 = OFFSET_X + TARGET_WIDTH - 1;
                        area.y2 = OFFSET_Y + ((i + 1) * chunk_lines) - 1;
                        
                        uint16_t *chunk_data = display_fb + (i * chunk_lines * TARGET_WIDTH);
                        
                        // Chama o driver de hardware do BSP nativamente
                        disp->flush_cb(disp, &area, (uint8_t*)chunk_data);
                        lv_display_flush_ready(disp); 
                    }
                }
                
                lvgl_port_unlock();
            }
        }
        
        // 4. RELATÓRIO DE FPS
        uint32_t now = xthal_get_ccount();
        if ((now - last_fps_tick) >= 240000000) {  
            ESP_LOGI(TAG, "Motor GBC: Logico: %lu FPS | Visual: %lu FPS", quadros_logicos, quadros_visuais);
            quadros_logicos = 0;
            quadros_visuais = 0;
            last_fps_tick = now;
        }

        // 5. TIMING DE ALTA PRECISÃO E WATCHDOG
        uint64_t frame_time_us = esp_timer_get_time() - frame_start_us;
        const uint64_t TARGET_TIME_US = 16666; // 16.6ms = 60 FPS cravados
        
        if (frame_time_us < TARGET_TIME_US) {
            // Se o frame foi rápido demais, cede a CPU para outras tasks enquanto o tempo não dá
            while (esp_timer_get_time() - frame_start_us < TARGET_TIME_US) {
                taskYIELD(); 
            }
        } else {
            // Se o frame atrasou (ex: cena pesada), não mandamos a CPU dormir! 
            // Apenas cedemos a CPU rapidamente a cada 10 frames para o Watchdog do ESP32 não reiniciar a placa.
            if (quadros_logicos % 10 == 0) {
                vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(1));
            } else {
                taskYIELD();
            }
        }
    }
    
    GbcEmulator::get_instance().emu_task_handle = NULL;
    vTaskDelete(NULL);
}

static lv_obj_t *scr_gbc_menu = NULL;
static lv_obj_t *scr_gbc_play = NULL;
static lv_obj_t *list_roms = NULL;

static void rom_click_cb(lv_event_t * e) {
    const char * path = (const char *)lv_event_get_user_data(e);
    
    // Mostra os controles de volume apenas se o processamento sonoro foi ativado
    if (audio_enabled) {
        lv_obj_remove_flag(btn_vol_up, LV_OBJ_FLAG_HIDDEN);
        lv_obj_remove_flag(btn_vol_down, LV_OBJ_FLAG_HIDDEN);
    } else {
        lv_obj_add_flag(btn_vol_up, LV_OBJ_FLAG_HIDDEN);
        lv_obj_add_flag(btn_vol_down, LV_OBJ_FLAG_HIDDEN);
    }

    lv_scr_load_anim(scr_gbc_play, LV_SCR_LOAD_ANIM_NONE, 0, 0, false);
    
    static char delayed_path[256];
    strncpy(delayed_path, path, sizeof(delayed_path));
    
    lv_timer_create([](lv_timer_t *t){
        GbcEmulator::get_instance().start(delayed_path);
        lv_timer_delete(t);
    }, 100, NULL);
}

static void refresh_rom_list() {
    lv_obj_clean(list_roms);
    DIR *dir = opendir("/sdcard/GB");
    if (dir) {
        struct dirent *ent;
        while ((ent = readdir(dir)) != NULL) {
            if (strstr(ent->d_name, ".gb") || strstr(ent->d_name, ".gbc")) {
                size_t path_len = strlen("/sdcard/GB/") + strlen(ent->d_name) + 1;
                char *full_path = (char*)malloc(path_len);
                snprintf(full_path, path_len, "/sdcard/GB/%s", ent->d_name);
                
                lv_obj_t *btn = lv_list_add_button(list_roms, LV_SYMBOL_PLAY, ent->d_name);
                style_list_item(btn);
                lv_obj_add_event_cb(btn, rom_click_cb, LV_EVENT_CLICKED, full_path);
            }
        }
        closedir(dir);
    } else {
        lv_obj_t *lbl = lv_list_add_text(list_roms, "Pasta /sdcard/GB vazia.");
        style_list_item(lbl);
    }
}

void app_gbc_emulator_init(void) {
    scr_gbc_menu = lv_obj_create(NULL);
    lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(scr_gbc_menu, lv_color_black(), 0);
    
    lv_obj_t * title = lv_label_create(scr_gbc_menu);
    lv_label_set_text(title, "Game Boy Color");
    lv_obj_set_style_text_color(title, lv_color_white(), 0); 
    lv_obj_set_style_text_font(title, &lv_font_montserrat_20, 0);
    lv_obj_align(title, LV_ALIGN_TOP_LEFT, 50, 30);

    // Switch de Áudio no Menu
    lv_obj_t * sw_audio = lv_switch_create(scr_gbc_menu);
    lv_obj_align(sw_audio, LV_ALIGN_TOP_RIGHT, -40, 30);
    if(audio_enabled) lv_obj_add_state(sw_audio, LV_STATE_CHECKED);

    lv_obj_t * label_audio = lv_label_create(scr_gbc_menu);
    lv_label_set_text(label_audio, LV_SYMBOL_VOLUME_MAX);
    lv_obj_set_style_text_color(label_audio, lv_color_white(), 0);
    lv_obj_align_to(label_audio, sw_audio, LV_ALIGN_OUT_LEFT_MID, -10, 0);

    lv_obj_add_event_cb(sw_audio, [](lv_event_t *e) {
        lv_obj_t * sw = (lv_obj_t *)lv_event_get_target(e);
        audio_enabled = lv_obj_has_state(sw, LV_STATE_CHECKED);
    }, LV_EVENT_VALUE_CHANGED, NULL);

    list_roms = lv_list_create(scr_gbc_menu);
    lv_obj_set_size(list_roms, 320, 350);
    lv_obj_align(list_roms, LV_ALIGN_BOTTOM_MID, 0, -20);
    lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(list_roms, lv_color_black(), 0);
    lv_obj_set_style_border_width(list_roms, 0, 0);

    lv_obj_add_event_cb(scr_gbc_menu, [](lv_event_t *e){
        lv_dir_t dir = lv_indev_get_gesture_dir(lv_indev_active());
        if(dir == LV_DIR_RIGHT && touch_start_x < 20) {
            lv_scr_load_anim(scr_apps, LV_SCR_LOAD_ANIM_MOVE_RIGHT, 300, 0, false);
        }
    }, LV_EVENT_GESTURE, NULL);
    lv_obj_add_event_cb(scr_gbc_menu, screen_pressed_cb, LV_EVENT_PRESSED, NULL);

    refresh_rom_list();

    // TELA DE JOGO COM OS BOTÕES (Sem imagens centrais)
    scr_gbc_play = lv_obj_create(NULL);
    lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(scr_gbc_play, lv_color_black(), 0);
    lv_obj_remove_flag(scr_gbc_play, LV_OBJ_FLAG_SCROLLABLE);

    // Botão sair
    lv_obj_t *btn_exit = lv_label_create(scr_gbc_play);
    lv_label_set_text(btn_exit, LV_SYMBOL_CLOSE);
    lv_obj_set_style_text_color(btn_exit, lv_color_hex(0xFF3333), 0);
    lv_obj_set_style_text_font(btn_exit, &lv_font_montserrat_14, 0);
    lv_obj_align(btn_exit, LV_ALIGN_TOP_LEFT, 90, 1);

    // Botão Volume UP
    btn_vol_up = lv_btn_create(scr_gbc_play);
    lv_obj_set_size(btn_vol_up, 25, 25);
    lv_obj_align(btn_vol_up, LV_ALIGN_RIGHT_MID, -10, -130);
    lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(btn_vol_up, lv_color_hex(0x333333), 0);
    lv_obj_add_flag(btn_vol_up, LV_OBJ_FLAG_HIDDEN); // Escondido inicialmente
    lv_obj_t * lbl_vup = lv_label_create(btn_vol_up);
    lv_label_set_text(lbl_vup, "+");
    lv_obj_center(lbl_vup);
    
    lv_obj_add_event_cb(btn_vol_up, [](lv_event_t *e) {
        if (current_volume < 100) current_volume += 5;
        bsp_extra_codec_volume_set(current_volume, NULL);
    }, LV_EVENT_CLICKED, NULL);

    // Botão Volume DOWN
    btn_vol_down = lv_btn_create(scr_gbc_play);
    lv_obj_set_size(btn_vol_down, 25, 25);
    lv_obj_align(btn_vol_down, LV_ALIGN_RIGHT_MID, -10, -80);
    lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(btn_vol_down, lv_color_hex(0x333333), 0);
    lv_obj_add_flag(btn_vol_down, LV_OBJ_FLAG_HIDDEN); // Escondido inicialmente
    lv_obj_t * lbl_vdown = lv_label_create(btn_vol_down);
    lv_label_set_text(lbl_vdown, "-");
    lv_obj_center(lbl_vdown);

    lv_obj_add_event_cb(btn_vol_down, [](lv_event_t *e) {
        if (current_volume > 0) current_volume -= 5;
        bsp_extra_codec_volume_set(current_volume, NULL);
    }, LV_EVENT_CLICKED, NULL);

    // Botão A (+ alto, maior)
    lv_obj_t * btn_a = lv_obj_create(scr_gbc_play);
    lv_obj_set_size(btn_a, 80, 80);
    lv_obj_align(btn_a, LV_ALIGN_BOTTOM_RIGHT, -20, -100);
    lv_obj_set_style_radius(btn_a, LV_RADIUS_CIRCLE, 0);
    lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(btn_a, lv_color_hex(0x9b2256), 0);
    lv_obj_set_style_border_width(btn_a, 0, 0);
    lv_obj_t * lbl_a = lv_label_create(btn_a);
    lv_label_set_text(lbl_a, "A");
    lv_obj_set_style_text_color(lbl_a, lv_color_white(), 0);
    lv_obj_center(lbl_a);

    // Botão B (+ alto, mais à esquerda, maior)
    lv_obj_t * btn_b = lv_obj_create(scr_gbc_play);
    lv_obj_set_size(btn_b, 80, 80);
    lv_obj_align(btn_b, LV_ALIGN_BOTTOM_RIGHT, -100, -50);
    lv_obj_set_style_radius(btn_b, LV_RADIUS_CIRCLE, 0);
    lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(btn_b, lv_color_hex(0x9b2256), 0);
    lv_obj_set_style_border_width(btn_b, 0, 0);
    lv_obj_t * lbl_b = lv_label_create(btn_b);
    lv_label_set_text(lbl_b, "B");
    lv_obj_set_style_text_color(lbl_b, lv_color_white(), 0);
    lv_obj_center(lbl_b);

    // Start (Em cima do Select)
    lv_obj_t * btn_start = lv_obj_create(scr_gbc_play);
    lv_obj_set_size(btn_start, 70, 25);
    lv_obj_align(btn_start, LV_ALIGN_BOTTOM_MID, -20, -55);
    lv_obj_set_style_radius(btn_start, 10, 0);
    lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(btn_start, lv_color_hex(0x444444), 0);
    lv_obj_set_style_border_width(btn_start, 0, 0);
    
    lv_obj_t * lbl_start = lv_label_create(btn_start);
    lv_label_set_text(lbl_start, "START");
    lv_obj_set_style_text_font(lbl_start, &lv_font_montserrat_14, 0);
    lv_obj_set_style_text_color(lbl_start, lv_color_white(), 0);
    lv_obj_center(lbl_start);

    // Select (Embaixo do Start, colado no fundo)
    lv_obj_t * btn_select = lv_obj_create(scr_gbc_play);
    lv_obj_set_size(btn_select, 70, 25);
    lv_obj_align(btn_select, LV_ALIGN_BOTTOM_MID, -20, -15);
    lv_obj_set_style_radius(btn_select, 10, 0);
    lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(btn_select, lv_color_hex(0x444444), 0);
    lv_obj_set_style_border_width(btn_select, 0, 0);

    lv_obj_t * lbl_select = lv_label_create(btn_select);
    lv_label_set_text(lbl_select, "SELECT");
    lv_obj_set_style_text_font(lbl_select, &lv_font_montserrat_14, 0);
    lv_obj_set_style_text_color(lbl_select, lv_color_white(), 0);
    lv_obj_center(lbl_select);

    // D-PAD Vertical
    // Comprimento: 140, Largura: 44
    lv_obj_t * dpad_v = lv_obj_create(scr_gbc_play);
    lv_obj_set_size(dpad_v, 44, 140);
    lv_obj_align(dpad_v, LV_ALIGN_BOTTOM_LEFT, 50, -30); 
    lv_obj_set_style_radius(dpad_v, 4, 0);
    lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(dpad_v, lv_color_hex(0x222222), 0);
    lv_obj_set_style_border_width(dpad_v, 0, 0);
    
    // D-PAD Horizontal
    // Comprimento: 140, Largura: 44
    lv_obj_t * dpad_h = lv_obj_create(scr_gbc_play);
    lv_obj_set_size(dpad_h, 140, 44);
    lv_obj_align(dpad_h, LV_ALIGN_BOTTOM_LEFT, 2, -78); // x=2 deixa o mais à esquerda possível
    lv_obj_set_style_radius(dpad_h, 4, 0);
    lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(dpad_h, lv_color_hex(0x222222), 0);
    lv_obj_set_style_border_width(dpad_h, 0, 0);
}

=== INÍCIO DO ARQUIVO: components/app_gbc_emulator/minigb_apu.c ===
/**
 * minigb_apu is released under the terms listed within the LICENSE file.
 *
 * minigb_apu emulates the audio processing unit (APU) of the Game Boy. This
 * project is based on MiniGBS by Alex Baines: https://github.com/baines/MiniGBS
 */

#include <assert.h>
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "minigb_apu.h"

#define DMG_CLOCK_FREQ_U	((unsigned)DMG_CLOCK_FREQ)
#define AUDIO_NSAMPLES		(AUDIO_SAMPLES_TOTAL)

#define AUDIO_MEM_SIZE		(0xFF3F - 0xFF10 + 1)
#define AUDIO_ADDR_COMPENSATION	0xFF10

#define MAX(a, b)		( a > b ? a : b )
#define MIN(a, b)		( a <= b ? a : b )

#define VOL_INIT_MAX		(INT16_MAX/8)
#define VOL_INIT_MIN		(INT16_MIN/8)

/* Handles time keeping for sound generation.
 * FREQ_INC_REF must be equal to, or larger than AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE in order
 * to avoid a division by zero error.
 * Using a square of 2 simplifies calculations. */
#define FREQ_INC_REF		(AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE * 16)

#define MAX_CHAN_VOLUME		15

/**
 * Memory holding audio registers between 0xFF10 and 0xFF3F inclusive.
 */
static uint8_t audio_mem[AUDIO_MEM_SIZE];

struct chan_len_ctr {
	uint8_t load;
	unsigned enabled : 1;
	uint32_t counter;
	uint32_t inc;
};

struct chan_vol_env {
	uint8_t step;
	unsigned up : 1;
	uint32_t counter;
	uint32_t inc;
};

struct chan_freq_sweep {
	uint16_t freq;
	uint8_t rate;
	uint8_t shift;
	unsigned up : 1;
	uint32_t counter;
	uint32_t inc;
};

static struct chan {
	unsigned enabled : 1;
	unsigned powered : 1;
	unsigned on_left : 1;
	unsigned on_right : 1;
	unsigned muted : 1;

	uint8_t volume;
	uint8_t volume_init;

	uint16_t freq;
	uint32_t freq_counter;
	uint32_t freq_inc;

	int_fast16_t val;

	struct chan_len_ctr    len;
	struct chan_vol_env    env;
	struct chan_freq_sweep sweep;

	union {
		struct {
			uint8_t duty;
			uint8_t duty_counter;
		} square;
		struct {
			uint16_t lfsr_reg;
			uint8_t  lfsr_wide;
			uint8_t  lfsr_div;
		} noise;
		struct {
			uint8_t sample;
		} wave;
	};
} chans[4];

static int32_t vol_l, vol_r;

static void set_note_freq(struct chan *c, const uint32_t freq)
{
	/* Lowest expected value of freq is 64. */
	c->freq_inc = freq * (uint32_t)(FREQ_INC_REF / AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE);
}

static void chan_enable(const uint_fast8_t i, const bool enable)
{
	uint8_t val;

	chans[i].enabled = enable;
	val = (audio_mem[0xFF26 - AUDIO_ADDR_COMPENSATION] & 0x80) |
		(chans[3].enabled << 3) | (chans[2].enabled << 2) |
		(chans[1].enabled << 1) | (chans[0].enabled << 0);

	audio_mem[0xFF26 - AUDIO_ADDR_COMPENSATION] = val;
	//audio_mem[0xFF26 - AUDIO_ADDR_COMPENSATION] |= 0x80 | ((uint8_t)enable) << i;
}

static void update_env(struct chan *c)
{
	c->env.counter += c->env.inc;

	while (c->env.counter > FREQ_INC_REF) {
		if (c->env.step) {
			c->volume += c->env.up ? 1 : -1;
			if (c->volume == 0 || c->volume == MAX_CHAN_VOLUME) {
				c->env.inc = 0;
			}
			c->volume = MAX(0, MIN(MAX_CHAN_VOLUME, c->volume));
		}
		c->env.counter -= FREQ_INC_REF;
	}
}

static void update_len(struct chan *c)
{
	if (!c->len.enabled)
		return;

	c->len.counter += c->len.inc;
	if (c->len.counter > FREQ_INC_REF) {
		chan_enable(c - chans, 0);
		c->len.counter = 0;
	}
}

static bool update_freq(struct chan *c, uint32_t *pos)
{
	uint32_t inc = c->freq_inc - *pos;
	c->freq_counter += inc;

	if (c->freq_counter > FREQ_INC_REF) {
		*pos		= c->freq_inc - (c->freq_counter - FREQ_INC_REF);
		c->freq_counter = 0;
		return true;
	} else {
		*pos = c->freq_inc;
		return false;
	}
}

static void update_sweep(struct chan *c)
{
	c->sweep.counter += c->sweep.inc;

	while (c->sweep.counter > FREQ_INC_REF) {
		if (c->sweep.shift) {
			uint16_t inc = (c->sweep.freq >> c->sweep.shift);
			if (!c->sweep.up)
				inc *= -1;

			c->freq += inc;
			if (c->freq > 2047) {
				c->enabled = 0;
			} else {
				set_note_freq(c,
					DMG_CLOCK_FREQ_U / ((2048 - c->freq)<< 5));
				c->freq_inc *= 8;
			}
		} else if (c->sweep.rate) {
			c->enabled = 0;
		}
		c->sweep.counter -= FREQ_INC_REF;
	}
}

static void update_square(int16_t* samples, const bool ch2)
{
	uint32_t freq;
	struct chan* c = chans + ch2;

	if (!c->powered || !c->enabled)
		return;

	freq = DMG_CLOCK_FREQ_U / ((2048 - c->freq) << 5);
	set_note_freq(c, freq);
	c->freq_inc *= 8;

	for (uint_fast16_t i = 0; i < AUDIO_NSAMPLES; i += 2) {
		update_len(c);

		if (!c->enabled)
			continue;

		update_env(c);
		if (!ch2)
			update_sweep(c);

		uint32_t pos = 0;
		uint32_t prev_pos = 0;
		int32_t sample = 0;

		while (update_freq(c, &pos)) {
			c->square.duty_counter = (c->square.duty_counter + 1) & 7;
			sample += ((pos - prev_pos) / c->freq_inc) * c->val;
			c->val = (c->square.duty & (1 << c->square.duty_counter)) ?
				VOL_INIT_MAX / MAX_CHAN_VOLUME :
				VOL_INIT_MIN / MAX_CHAN_VOLUME;
			prev_pos = pos;
		}

		if (c->muted)
			continue;

		sample += c->val;
		sample *= c->volume;
		sample /= 4;

		samples[i + 0] += sample * c->on_left * vol_l;
		samples[i + 1] += sample * c->on_right * vol_r;
	}
}

static uint8_t wave_sample(const unsigned int pos, const unsigned int volume)
{
	uint8_t sample;

	sample =  audio_mem[(0xFF30 + pos / 2) - AUDIO_ADDR_COMPENSATION];
	if (pos & 1) {
		sample &= 0xF;
	} else {
		sample >>= 4;
	}
	return volume ? (sample >> (volume - 1)) : 0;
}

static void update_wave(int16_t *samples)
{
	uint32_t freq;
	struct chan *c = chans + 2;

	if (!c->powered || !c->enabled)
		return;

	freq = (DMG_CLOCK_FREQ_U / 64) / (2048 - c->freq);
	set_note_freq(c, freq);

	c->freq_inc *= 32;

	for (uint_fast16_t i = 0; i < AUDIO_NSAMPLES; i += 2) {
		update_len(c);

		if (!c->enabled)
			continue;

		uint32_t pos      = 0;
		uint32_t prev_pos = 0;
		int32_t sample   = 0;

		c->wave.sample = wave_sample(c->val, c->volume);

		while (update_freq(c, &pos)) {
			c->val = (c->val + 1) & 31;
			sample += ((pos - prev_pos) / c->freq_inc) *
				((int)c->wave.sample - 8) * (INT16_MAX/64);
			c->wave.sample = wave_sample(c->val, c->volume);
			prev_pos  = pos;
		}

		sample += ((int)c->wave.sample - 8) * (int)(INT16_MAX/64);

		if (c->volume == 0)
			continue;

		{
			/* First element is unused. */
			int16_t div[] = { INT16_MAX, 1, 2, 4 };
			sample = sample / (div[c->volume]);
		}

		if (c->muted)
			continue;

		sample /= 4;

		samples[i + 0] += sample * c->on_left * vol_l;
		samples[i + 1] += sample * c->on_right * vol_r;
	}
}

static void update_noise(int16_t *samples)
{
	struct chan *c = chans + 3;

	if (!c->powered)
		return;

	{
		const uint32_t lfsr_div_lut[] = {
			8, 16, 32, 48, 64, 80, 96, 112
		};
		uint32_t freq;

		freq = DMG_CLOCK_FREQ_U / (lfsr_div_lut[c->noise.lfsr_div] << c->freq);
		set_note_freq(c, freq);
	}

	if (c->freq >= 14)
		c->enabled = 0;

	for (uint_fast16_t i = 0; i < AUDIO_NSAMPLES; i += 2) {
		update_len(c);

		if (!c->enabled)
			continue;

		update_env(c);

		uint32_t pos      = 0;
		uint32_t prev_pos = 0;
		int32_t sample    = 0;

		while (update_freq(c, &pos)) {
			c->noise.lfsr_reg = (c->noise.lfsr_reg << 1) |
				(c->val >= VOL_INIT_MAX/MAX_CHAN_VOLUME);

			if (c->noise.lfsr_wide) {
				c->val = !(((c->noise.lfsr_reg >> 14) & 1) ^
						((c->noise.lfsr_reg >> 13) & 1)) ?
					VOL_INIT_MAX / MAX_CHAN_VOLUME :
					VOL_INIT_MIN / MAX_CHAN_VOLUME;
			} else {
				c->val = !(((c->noise.lfsr_reg >> 6) & 1) ^
						((c->noise.lfsr_reg >> 5) & 1)) ?
					VOL_INIT_MAX / MAX_CHAN_VOLUME :
					VOL_INIT_MIN / MAX_CHAN_VOLUME;
			}

			sample += ((pos - prev_pos) / c->freq_inc) * c->val;
			prev_pos = pos;
		}

		if (c->muted)
			continue;

		sample += c->val;
		sample *= c->volume;
		sample /= 4;

		samples[i + 0] += sample * c->on_left * vol_l;
		samples[i + 1] += sample * c->on_right * vol_r;
	}
}

/**
 * SDL2 style audio callback function.
 */
void audio_callback(void *userdata, void *stream, int sz)
{
	int16_t *samples = stream;
	assert(sz == (AUDIO_SAMPLES * 2 * sizeof(int16_t)));

	/* userdata is unused and only here for ease of use with SDL2. */
	(void) userdata;

	memset(samples, 0, sz);
	update_square(samples, 0);
	update_square(samples, 1);
	update_wave(samples);
	update_noise(samples);
}

static void chan_trigger(uint_fast8_t i)
{
	struct chan *c = chans + i;

	chan_enable(i, 1);
	c->volume = c->volume_init;

	// volume envelope
	{
		uint8_t val =
			audio_mem[(0xFF12 + (i * 5)) - AUDIO_ADDR_COMPENSATION];

		c->env.step = val & 0x07;
		c->env.up   = val & 0x08 ? 1 : 0;
		c->env.inc  = c->env.step ?
			(FREQ_INC_REF * 64ul) / ((uint32_t)c->env.step * AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE) :
			(8ul * FREQ_INC_REF) / AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE ;
		c->env.counter = 0;
	}

	// freq sweep
	if (i == 0) {
		uint8_t val = audio_mem[0xFF10 - AUDIO_ADDR_COMPENSATION];

		c->sweep.freq  = c->freq;
		c->sweep.rate  = (val >> 4) & 0x07;
		c->sweep.up    = !(val & 0x08);
		c->sweep.shift = (val & 0x07);
		c->sweep.inc   = c->sweep.rate ?
			((128 * FREQ_INC_REF) / (c->sweep.rate * AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE)) : 0;
		c->sweep.counter = FREQ_INC_REF;
	}

	int len_max = 64;

	if (i == 2) { // wave
		len_max = 256;
		c->val = 0;
	} else if (i == 3) { // noise
		c->noise.lfsr_reg = 0xFFFF;
		c->val = VOL_INIT_MIN / MAX_CHAN_VOLUME;
	}

	c->len.inc = (256 * FREQ_INC_REF) / (AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE * (len_max - c->len.load));
	c->len.counter = 0;
}

/**
 * Read audio register.
 * \param addr	Address of audio register. Must be 0xFF10 <= addr <= 0xFF3F.
 *				This is not checked in this function.
 * \return	Byte at address.
 */
uint8_t minigb_audio_read(const uint16_t addr)
{
	static const uint8_t ortab[] = {
		0x80, 0x3f, 0x00, 0xff, 0xbf,
		0xff, 0x3f, 0x00, 0xff, 0xbf,
		0x7f, 0xff, 0x9f, 0xff, 0xbf,
		0xff, 0xff, 0x00, 0x00, 0xbf,
		0x00, 0x00, 0x70,
		0xff, 0xff, 0xff, 0xff, 0xff, 0xff, 0xff, 0xff, 0xff,
		0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,
		0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00
	};

	return audio_mem[addr - AUDIO_ADDR_COMPENSATION] |
		ortab[addr - AUDIO_ADDR_COMPENSATION];
}

/**
 * Write audio register.
 * \param addr	Address of audio register. Must be 0xFF10 <= addr <= 0xFF3F.
 *				This is not checked in this function.
 * \param val	Byte to write at address.
 */
void minigb_audio_write(const uint16_t addr, const uint8_t val)
{
	/* Find sound channel corresponding to register address. */
	uint_fast8_t i;

	if(addr == 0xFF26)
	{
		audio_mem[addr - AUDIO_ADDR_COMPENSATION] = val & 0x80;
		/* On APU power off, clear all registers apart from wave
		 * RAM. */
		if((val & 0x80) == 0)
		{
			memset(audio_mem, 0x00, 0xFF26 - AUDIO_ADDR_COMPENSATION);
			chans[0].enabled = false;
			chans[1].enabled = false;
			chans[2].enabled = false;
			chans[3].enabled = false;
		}

		return;
	}

	/* Ignore register writes if APU powered off. */
	if(audio_mem[0xFF26 - AUDIO_ADDR_COMPENSATION] == 0x00)
		return;

	audio_mem[addr - AUDIO_ADDR_COMPENSATION] = val;
	i = (addr - AUDIO_ADDR_COMPENSATION) / 5;

	switch (addr) {
	case 0xFF12:
	case 0xFF17:
	case 0xFF21: {
		chans[i].volume_init = val >> 4;
		chans[i].powered     = (val >> 3) != 0;

		// "zombie mode" stuff, needed for Prehistorik Man and probably
		// others
		if (chans[i].powered && chans[i].enabled) {
			if ((chans[i].env.step == 0 && chans[i].env.inc != 0)) {
				if (val & 0x08) {
					chans[i].volume++;
				} else {
					chans[i].volume += 2;
				}
			} else {
				chans[i].volume = 16 - chans[i].volume;
			}

			chans[i].volume &= 0x0F;
			chans[i].env.step = val & 0x07;
		}
	} break;

	case 0xFF1C:
		chans[i].volume = chans[i].volume_init = (val >> 5) & 0x03;
		break;

	case 0xFF11:
	case 0xFF16:
	case 0xFF20: {
		const uint8_t duty_lookup[] = { 0x10, 0x30, 0x3C, 0xCF };
		chans[i].len.load = val & 0x3f;
		chans[i].square.duty = duty_lookup[val >> 6];
		break;
	}

	case 0xFF1B:
		chans[i].len.load = val;
		break;

	case 0xFF13:
	case 0xFF18:
	case 0xFF1D:
		chans[i].freq &= 0xFF00;
		chans[i].freq |= val;
		break;

	case 0xFF1A:
		chans[i].powered = (val & 0x80) != 0;
		chan_enable(i, val & 0x80);
		break;

	case 0xFF14:
	case 0xFF19:
	case 0xFF1E:
		chans[i].freq &= 0x00FF;
		chans[i].freq |= ((val & 0x07) << 8);
		/* Intentional fall-through. */
	case 0xFF23:
		chans[i].len.enabled = val & 0x40 ? 1 : 0;
		if (val & 0x80)
			chan_trigger(i);

		break;

	case 0xFF22:
		chans[3].freq = val >> 4;
		chans[3].noise.lfsr_wide = !(val & 0x08);
		chans[3].noise.lfsr_div = val & 0x07;
		break;

	case 0xFF24:
	{
		vol_l = ((val >> 4) & 0x07);
		vol_r = (val & 0x07);
		break;
	}

	case 0xFF25:
		for (uint_fast8_t j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
			chans[j].on_left  = (val >> (4 + j)) & 1;
			chans[j].on_right = (val >> j) & 1;
		}
		break;
	}
}

void audio_init(void)
{
	/* Initialise channels and samples. */
	memset(chans, 0, sizeof(chans));
	chans[0].val = chans[1].val = -1;

	/* Initialise IO registers. */
	{
		const uint8_t regs_init[] = { 0x80, 0xBF, 0xF3, 0xFF, 0x3F,
					      0xFF, 0x3F, 0x00, 0xFF, 0x3F,
					      0x7F, 0xFF, 0x9F, 0xFF, 0x3F,
					      0xFF, 0xFF, 0x00, 0x00, 0x3F,
					      0x77, 0xF3, 0xF1 };

		for(uint_fast8_t i = 0; i < sizeof(regs_init); ++i)
			minigb_audio_write(0xFF10 + i, regs_init[i]);
	}

	/* Initialise Wave Pattern RAM. */
	{
		const uint8_t wave_init[] = { 0xac, 0xdd, 0xda, 0x48,
					      0x36, 0x02, 0xcf, 0x16,
					      0x2c, 0x04, 0xe5, 0x2c,
					      0xac, 0xdd, 0xda, 0x48 };

		for(uint_fast8_t i = 0; i < sizeof(wave_init); ++i)
			minigb_audio_write(0xFF30 + i, wave_init[i]);
	}
}

=== INÍCIO DO ARQUIVO: components/app_netinfo/app_netinfo.cpp ===
#include "app_netinfo.h"
#include "esp_netif.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <cstring>
#include "ui_common.h"

static lv_obj_t *scr_app_netinfo = NULL;
static lv_obj_t *label_netinfo = NULL; 

// [NOVO] Função local do componente para capturar onde o dedo tocou
static void local_screen_pressed_cb(lv_event_t * e) {
    lv_indev_t * indev = lv_indev_active();
    if(indev) {
        lv_point_t p;
        lv_indev_get_point(indev, &p);
        touch_start_x = p.x; 
    }
    // [NOVO] Reseta o timer global de energia ao tocar na tela do app
    reset_inactivity_timer();
}

static void netinfo_gesture_cb(lv_event_t * e) {
    lv_indev_t * indev = lv_indev_active();
    if(indev == NULL) return;
    lv_dir_t dir = lv_indev_get_gesture_dir(indev);
    if(dir == LV_DIR_RIGHT && touch_start_x < 20) {
        lv_scr_load_anim(scr_apps, LV_SCR_LOAD_ANIM_MOVE_RIGHT, 300, 0, false);
    }
}

void app_netinfo_init(void) {
    scr_app_netinfo = lv_obj_create(NULL);
    lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(scr_app_netinfo, lv_color_black(), 0);
    
    // Agora usa a função local em vez de tentar buscar da main
    lv_obj_add_event_cb(scr_app_netinfo, local_screen_pressed_cb, LV_EVENT_PRESSED, NULL); 
    lv_obj_add_event_cb(scr_app_netinfo, netinfo_gesture_cb, LV_EVENT_GESTURE, NULL);

    lv_obj_t * label_netinfo_title = lv_label_create(scr_app_netinfo);
    lv_obj_set_style_text_color(label_netinfo_title, lv_color_white(), 0); 
    lv_obj_set_style_text_font(label_netinfo_title, &lv_font_montserrat_20, 0);
    lv_label_set_text(label_netinfo_title, "Status da Rede");
    lv_obj_align(label_netinfo_title, LV_ALIGN_TOP_LEFT, 50, 30);

    label_netinfo = lv_label_create(scr_app_netinfo);
    lv_obj_set_style_text_color(label_netinfo, lv_color_white(), 0);
    lv_obj_set_style_text_font(label_netinfo, &lv_font_montserrat_20, 0);
    lv_label_set_text(label_netinfo, "Carregando...");
    lv_obj_align(label_netinfo, LV_ALIGN_TOP_LEFT, 40, 80);
}

lv_obj_t * app_netinfo_get_screen(void) {
    return scr_app_netinfo;
}

void app_netinfo_update(bool wifi_connected, const char *ssid) {
    if (!label_netinfo) return;

    if (wifi_connected) {
        esp_netif_t *netif = esp_netif_get_handle_from_ifkey("WIFI_STA_DEF");
        if (netif) {
            esp_netif_ip_info_t ip_info;
            esp_netif_dns_info_t dns_info;
            esp_netif_get_ip_info(netif, &ip_info);
            esp_netif_get_dns_info(netif, ESP_NETIF_DNS_MAIN, &dns_info);

            char info_buf[256];
            snprintf(info_buf, sizeof(info_buf),
                     "Rede: %s\n\n"
                     "IP: " IPSTR "\n"
                     "Mascara: " IPSTR "\n"
                     "Gateway: " IPSTR "\n"
                     "DNS: " IPSTR,
                     (ssid && strlen(ssid) > 0) ? ssid : "Desconhecido",
                     IP2STR(&ip_info.ip),
                     IP2STR(&ip_info.netmask),
                     IP2STR(&ip_info.gw),
                     IP2STR(&dns_info.ip.u_addr.ip4));
            
            lv_label_set_text(label_netinfo, info_buf);
        } else {
            lv_label_set_text(label_netinfo, "Erro ao obter dados\nda interface.");
        }
    } else {
        lv_label_set_text(label_netinfo, "Wi-Fi Desligado.\nSem dados de rede.");
    }
}=== FIM DO ARQUIVO ===

=== INÍCIO DO ARQUIVO: components/app_nettools/app_nettools.cpp ===
#include "app_nettools.h"
#include "ui_common.h"
#include "esp_log.h"
#include "ping/ping_sock.h"
#include <arpa/inet.h>
#include "lwip/sockets.h"
#include "lwip/netdb.h"
#include "bsp/esp-bsp.h"

static const char *TAG = "NetTools";

// Elementos Visuais Globais do App
static lv_obj_t *scr_menu_nettools = NULL;
static lv_obj_t *list_tools = NULL;

// ---------------------------------------------------------
// COMPONENTES - PING UTILITY
// ---------------------------------------------------------
static lv_obj_t *scr_ping = NULL;
static lv_obj_t *ta_ip = NULL;
static lv_obj_t *kb_ping = NULL;
static lv_obj_t *btn_start_ping = NULL;
static lv_obj_t *label_ping_output = NULL;
static lv_obj_t *container_output = NULL;
static esp_ping_handle_t ping_handle = NULL;

#define MAX_MSG_LEN 128
static char ping_msg_queue[MAX_MSG_LEN] = {0};
static volatile bool has_new_msg = false;

// ---------------------------------------------------------
// COMPONENTES - PORT DISCOVERY
// ---------------------------------------------------------
static lv_obj_t *scr_port = NULL;
static lv_obj_t *ta_scan_ip = NULL;
static lv_obj_t *ta_scan_port = NULL; // Nova caixa para porta opcional
static lv_obj_t *kb_scan = NULL;
static lv_obj_t *btn_start_scan = NULL;
static lv_obj_t *label_scan_output = NULL;
static lv_obj_t *container_scan_output = NULL;

static TaskHandle_t scan_task_handle = NULL;
static volatile bool stop_scan_task = false;
static char scan_msg_queue[MAX_MSG_LEN] = {0};
static volatile bool has_scan_msg = false;

// Variáveis para transportar os dados do LVGL para a Task
static char target_scan_ip[32];
static uint16_t target_scan_port = 0;

// Top 22 Portas (Padrões + Homelab)
const uint16_t top_ports[] = {
    21, 22, 23, 53, 80, 111, 139, 443, 445, // Web e Infra básica
    1883,  // MQTT
    3306,  // MySQL / MariaDB
    3389,  // RDP (Windows Remote Desktop)
    7125,  // Klipper / Moonraker (Impressão 3D)
    8000,  // Portainer Edge / Proxies
    8006,  // Proxmox VE
    8080,  // Web-Alt
    8123,  // Home Assistant
    8443,  // Web-Alt HTTPS / Unifi Controller
    9000,  // Portainer GUI
    9443,  // Portainer HTTPS
    32400, // Plex Media Server
    61208  // Glances (Monitoramento)
};

// =========================================================
// EVENTOS DE GESTOS E TOQUE
// =========================================================
static void local_screen_pressed_cb(lv_event_t * e) {
    if(lv_indev_active()) {
        lv_point_t p;
        lv_indev_get_point(lv_indev_active(), &p);
        touch_start_x = p.x; 
    }
    reset_inactivity_timer();
}

static void tools_gesture_cb(lv_event_t * e) {
    lv_dir_t dir = lv_indev_get_gesture_dir(lv_indev_active());
    if(dir == LV_DIR_RIGHT && touch_start_x < 20) {
        lv_scr_load_anim(scr_apps, LV_SCR_LOAD_ANIM_MOVE_RIGHT, 300, 0, false);
    }
}

static void sub_screen_ping_gesture_cb(lv_event_t * e) {
    lv_dir_t dir = lv_indev_get_gesture_dir(lv_indev_active());
    if(dir == LV_DIR_RIGHT && touch_start_x < 20) {
        if (ping_handle) {
            esp_ping_stop(ping_handle);
            esp_ping_delete_session(ping_handle);
            ping_handle = NULL;
        }
        lv_scr_load_anim(scr_menu_nettools, LV_SCR_LOAD_ANIM_MOVE_RIGHT, 300, 0, false);
    }
}

static void sub_screen_scan_gesture_cb(lv_event_t * e) {
    lv_dir_t dir = lv_indev_get_gesture_dir(lv_indev_active());
    if(dir == LV_DIR_RIGHT && touch_start_x < 20) {
        // Sinaliza para a Task do Scanner parar de procurar e morrer
        if (scan_task_handle != NULL) {
            stop_scan_task = true; 
        }
        lv_scr_load_anim(scr_menu_nettools, LV_SCR_LOAD_ANIM_MOVE_RIGHT, 300, 0, false);
    }
}

// =========================================================
// ATUALIZADOR SEGURO DE UI (CORE 0)
// =========================================================
static void ui_update_timer_cb(lv_timer_t * timer) {
    // Atualiza mensagens do Ping
    if (has_new_msg) {
        if (bsp_display_lock(pdMS_TO_TICKS(50))) {
            if (label_ping_output && container_output) {
                lv_label_ins_text(label_ping_output, LV_LABEL_POS_LAST, ping_msg_queue);
                lv_obj_scroll_to_y(container_output, LV_COORD_MAX, LV_ANIM_ON);
            }
            bsp_display_unlock();
        }
        has_new_msg = false;
    }

    // Atualiza mensagens do Port Scanner
    if (has_scan_msg) {
        if (bsp_display_lock(pdMS_TO_TICKS(50))) {
            if (label_scan_output && container_scan_output) {
                lv_label_ins_text(label_scan_output, LV_LABEL_POS_LAST, scan_msg_queue);
                lv_obj_scroll_to_y(container_scan_output, LV_COORD_MAX, LV_ANIM_ON);
            }
            bsp_display_unlock();
        }
        has_scan_msg = false;
    }
}

// =========================================================
// LÓGICA DO PING
// =========================================================
static void cmd_ping_on_ping_success(esp_ping_handle_t h, void *args) {
    if (has_new_msg) return; 

    uint8_t ttl;
    uint16_t seqno;
    uint32_t elapsed_time, recv_len;
    ip_addr_t target_addr;
    
    esp_ping_get_profile(h, ESP_PING_PROF_TTL, &ttl, sizeof(ttl));
    esp_ping_get_profile(h, ESP_PING_PROF_SEQNO, &seqno, sizeof(seqno));
    esp_ping_get_profile(h, ESP_PING_PROF_SIZE, &recv_len, sizeof(recv_len));
    esp_ping_get_profile(h, ESP_PING_PROF_TIMEGAP, &elapsed_time, sizeof(elapsed_time));
    esp_ping_get_profile(h, ESP_PING_PROF_IPADDR, &target_addr, sizeof(target_addr));

    snprintf(ping_msg_queue, sizeof(ping_msg_queue), "\n%lu bytes de %s: seq=%d ttl=%d tempo=%lu ms",
             (unsigned long)recv_len, ipaddr_ntoa(&target_addr), seqno, ttl, (unsigned long)elapsed_time);
    has_new_msg = true;
}

static void cmd_ping_on_ping_timeout(esp_ping_handle_t h, void *args) {
    if (has_new_msg) return;
    snprintf(ping_msg_queue, sizeof(ping_msg_queue), "\nSolicitacao expirada (Timeout).");
    has_new_msg = true;
}

static void cmd_ping_on_ping_end(esp_ping_handle_t h, void *args) {
    if (has_new_msg) return;
    snprintf(ping_msg_queue, sizeof(ping_msg_queue), "\n--- Teste Concluido ---");
    has_new_msg = true;
    ping_handle = NULL;
}

static void hide_ping_keyboard(void * obj) {
    if (bsp_display_lock(0)) {
        lv_obj_add_flag(kb_ping, LV_OBJ_FLAG_HIDDEN);
        lv_obj_remove_flag(container_output, LV_OBJ_FLAG_HIDDEN);
        bsp_display_unlock();
    }
}

static void start_ping_action(void) {
    const char *target_ip = lv_textarea_get_text(ta_ip);
    if (strlen(target_ip) == 0) return;

    lv_async_call(hide_ping_keyboard, NULL);

    if (bsp_display_lock(0)) {
        lv_label_set_text_fmt(label_ping_output, "Disparando contra %s:", target_ip);
        bsp_display_unlock();
    }

    ip_addr_t target_addr;
    memset(&target_addr, 0, sizeof(target_addr));
    if (ipaddr_aton(target_ip, &target_addr) == 0) {
        if (bsp_display_lock(0)) {
            lv_label_set_text(label_ping_output, "Erro: Endereco IP Invalido.");
            bsp_display_unlock();
        }
        return;
    }

    esp_ping_config_t ping_config = ESP_PING_DEFAULT_CONFIG();
    ping_config.target_addr = target_addr;
    ping_config.count = 5; 
    ping_config.interval_ms = 1000; 

    esp_ping_callbacks_t cbs;
    memset(&cbs, 0, sizeof(cbs));
    cbs.on_ping_success = cmd_ping_on_ping_success;
    cbs.on_ping_timeout = cmd_ping_on_ping_timeout;
    cbs.on_ping_end = cmd_ping_on_ping_end;

    if (ping_handle) {
        esp_ping_stop(ping_handle);
        esp_ping_delete_session(ping_handle);
    }
    esp_ping_new_session(&ping_config, &cbs, &ping_handle);
    esp_ping_start(ping_handle);
}

// =========================================================
// LÓGICA DO PORT DISCOVERY (FREERTOS TASK)
// =========================================================

// Função helper para enviar mensagens da Task para o LVGL
static void send_scan_msg(const char* msg) {
    while (has_scan_msg && !stop_scan_task) {
        vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(10)); // Aguarda o LVGL consumir a msg anterior
    }
    if (!stop_scan_task) {
        strncpy(scan_msg_queue, msg, MAX_MSG_LEN - 1);
        has_scan_msg = true;
    }
}

// Tenta abrir Socket TCP com Timeout rápido
static bool is_port_open(const char *ip, uint16_t port) {
    int sock = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, IPPROTO_TCP);
    if (sock < 0) return false;

    // Configura Socket como Não-Bloqueante
    int flags = fcntl(sock, F_GETFL, 0);
    fcntl(sock, F_SETFL, flags | O_NONBLOCK);

    struct sockaddr_in server_addr;
    memset(&server_addr, 0, sizeof(server_addr));
    server_addr.sin_family = AF_INET;
    server_addr.sin_port = htons(port);
    inet_pton(AF_INET, ip, &server_addr.sin_addr);

    // Inicia a tentativa de conexão
    int res = connect(sock, (struct sockaddr *)&server_addr, sizeof(server_addr));
    if (res < 0 && errno != EINPROGRESS && errno != EWOULDBLOCK) {
        close(sock);
        return false;
    }

    // Configura o Timeout do Select (300 milissegundos)
    fd_set fdset;
    FD_ZERO(&fdset);
    FD_SET(sock, &fdset);
    struct timeval tv;
    tv.tv_sec = 0;
    tv.tv_usec = 300000; 

    res = select(sock + 1, NULL, &fdset, NULL, &tv);
    bool is_open = false;
    if (res > 0) { // O Socket respondeu
        int so_error = 0;
        socklen_t len = sizeof(so_error);
        getsockopt(sock, SOL_SOCKET, SO_ERROR, &so_error, &len);
        if (so_error == 0) {
            is_open = true; // Porta aberta!
        }
    }
    
    close(sock);
    return is_open;
}

// A Task que roda em background
static void port_scan_task(void *pvParameters) {
    send_scan_msg("\nIniciando varredura...");
    vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(100)); // Pequena pausa para a UI atualizar

    if (target_scan_port > 0) {
        // Varredura de Porta Única Customizada
        char buf[64];
        snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "\nTestando porta %d...", target_scan_port);
        send_scan_msg(buf);
        
        if (is_port_open(target_scan_ip, target_scan_port)) {
            snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "\n[+] Porta %d ABERTA", target_scan_port);
            send_scan_msg(buf);
        } else {
            snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "\n[-] Porta %d fechada", target_scan_port);
            send_scan_msg(buf);
        }
    } else {
        // Varredura do Homelab Top 22
        int total_ports = sizeof(top_ports) / sizeof(top_ports[0]);
        for (int i = 0; i < total_ports; i++) {
            if (stop_scan_task) break; // Interrompe se o usuário arrastar para sair da tela
            
            if (is_port_open(target_scan_ip, top_ports[i])) {
                char buf[64];
                snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "\n[+] Porta %d ABERTA", top_ports[i]);
                send_scan_msg(buf);
            }
            vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(50)); // Respiro pro chip de rede
        }
    }
    
    if (!stop_scan_task) {
        send_scan_msg("\n--- Teste Concluido ---");
    }
    
    scan_task_handle = NULL;
    vTaskDelete(NULL); // Mata a task
}

static void hide_scan_keyboard(void * obj) {
    if (bsp_display_lock(0)) {
        lv_obj_add_flag(kb_scan, LV_OBJ_FLAG_HIDDEN);
        lv_obj_remove_flag(container_scan_output, LV_OBJ_FLAG_HIDDEN);
        bsp_display_unlock();
    }
}

static void start_scan_action(void) {
    const char *ip_str = lv_textarea_get_text(ta_scan_ip);
    const char *port_str = lv_textarea_get_text(ta_scan_port);
    
    if (strlen(ip_str) == 0) return;

    // Salva nas globais para a Task ler
    strncpy(target_scan_ip, ip_str, sizeof(target_scan_ip) - 1);
    target_scan_port = (strlen(port_str) > 0) ? atoi(port_str) : 0;

    lv_async_call(hide_scan_keyboard, NULL);

    if (bsp_display_lock(0)) {
        if (target_scan_port > 0) {
            lv_label_set_text_fmt(label_scan_output, "Alvo: %s:%d", target_scan_ip, target_scan_port);
        } else {
            lv_label_set_text_fmt(label_scan_output, "Scan Top 20: %s", target_scan_ip);
        }
        bsp_display_unlock();
    }

    // Se já tinha uma task rodando, não sobrepõe
    if (scan_task_handle == NULL) {
        stop_scan_task = false;
        has_scan_msg = false;
        // Cria a Task na CPU 1 com stack generoso de 4KB
        xTaskCreatePinnedToCore(port_scan_task, "port_scan", 4096, NULL, 5, &scan_task_handle, 1);
    }
}

#include "SdUsbManager.hpp"
#include "esp_log.h"
#include "esp_vfs_fat.h"
#include "tinyusb.h"
#include "tusb_msc_storage.h"
#include "driver/gpio.h" // [NOVO] Necessário para manipular os pinos USB

// Pinos do SD Card confirmados via diagrama da Waveshare
#define PIN_NUM_MOSI 1
#define PIN_NUM_CLK  2
#define PIN_NUM_MISO 3
#define PIN_NUM_CS   17 

static const char *TAG = "SdUsbMgr";

esp_err_t SdUsbManager::init_local_storage() {
    if (sd_initialized && !msc_active) return ESP_OK;

    ESP_LOGI(TAG, "Montando Cartao SD no ESP32...");

    sdmmc_host_t host = SDSPI_HOST_DEFAULT();
    
    // Força o uso do SPI3_HOST para não conflitar com o Display AMOLED (SPI2_HOST)
    host.slot = SPI3_HOST; 
    
    spi_bus_config_t bus_cfg = {};
    bus_cfg.mosi_io_num = PIN_NUM_MOSI;
    bus_cfg.miso_io_num = PIN_NUM_MISO;
    bus_cfg.sclk_io_num = PIN_NUM_CLK;
    bus_cfg.quadwp_io_num = -1;
    bus_cfg.quadhd_io_num = -1;
    bus_cfg.max_transfer_sz = 4000;

    // Inicializa no SPI3. Ignora se já estiver ligado.
    esp_err_t err = spi_bus_initialize((spi_host_device_t)host.slot, &bus_cfg, SDSPI_DEFAULT_DMA);
    if (err != ESP_OK && err != ESP_ERR_INVALID_STATE) {
        ESP_LOGE(TAG, "Falha ao inicializar barramento SPI: %s", esp_err_to_name(err));
        return err;
    }

    sdspi_device_config_t slot_config = SDSPI_DEVICE_CONFIG_DEFAULT();
    slot_config.gpio_cs = (gpio_num_t)PIN_NUM_CS;
    slot_config.host_id = (spi_host_device_t)host.slot;

    esp_vfs_fat_sdmmc_mount_config_t mount_config = {};
    mount_config.format_if_mount_failed = false;
    mount_config.max_files = 5;
    mount_config.allocation_unit_size = 16 * 1024;

    esp_err_t ret = esp_vfs_fat_sdspi_mount(mount_point, &host, &slot_config, &mount_config, &card);

    if (ret != ESP_OK) {
        ESP_LOGE(TAG, "Falha ao montar SD Card (0x%x). Verifique os pinos/cartao.", ret);
        return ret;
    }

    sd_initialized = true;
    msc_active = false;
    ESP_LOGI(TAG, "SD Card montado com sucesso em %s", mount_point);
    return ESP_OK;
}

esp_err_t SdUsbManager::enable_usb_msc() {
    if (msc_active) return ESP_OK;

    // Trava anti-crash. Se não houver SD Card, o botão não faz nada e não reinicia a placa.
    if (card == nullptr) {
        ESP_LOGE(TAG, "Cartao SD nao foi inicializado no boot! Abortando MSC para evitar Crash.");
        return ESP_FAIL;
    }

    ESP_LOGI(TAG, "Iniciando TinyUSB MSC...");
    
    tinyusb_config_t tusb_cfg = {};
    
    esp_err_t ret = tinyusb_driver_install(&tusb_cfg);
    if (ret != ESP_OK && ret != ESP_ERR_INVALID_STATE) {
        ESP_LOGE(TAG, "Falha ao instalar TinyUSB");
        return ret;
    }

    tinyusb_msc_sdmmc_config_t msc_config = {};
    msc_config.card = card;

    ret = tinyusb_msc_storage_init_sdmmc(&msc_config);
    if (ret != ESP_OK) {
        ESP_LOGE(TAG, "Falha ao vincular SD ao TinyUSB");
        return ret;
    }

    msc_active = true;
    ESP_LOGI(TAG, "Modo Pendrive Ativo! Conecte no PC.");
    return ESP_OK;
}

esp_err_t SdUsbManager::disable_usb_msc() {
    if (!msc_active) return ESP_OK;

    ESP_LOGI(TAG, "Saindo do Modo Pendrive. O sistema sera reiniciado para restaurar o Monitor Serial...");

    // 1. Derruba fisicamente os pinos USB internos do ESP32-S3 (GPIO 19 e 20)
    // Isso força o Windows a registrar a remoção do Pendrive IMEDIATAMENTE.
    gpio_reset_pin(GPIO_NUM_19);
    gpio_reset_pin(GPIO_NUM_20);
    gpio_set_direction(GPIO_NUM_19, GPIO_MODE_INPUT);
    gpio_set_direction(GPIO_NUM_20, GPIO_MODE_INPUT);

    // 2. Aguarda 2.5 segundos para o PC tocar o som de "desconectado" e limpar a porta COM
    vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(2500));

    // 3. Reinicia o ESP32 graciosamente. O Bootloader vai restaurar o USB JTAG/Serial automaticamente.
    esp_restart();

    return ESP_OK; // O código nunca chegará aqui devido ao reboot
}=== FIM DO ARQUIVO ===

uint8_t dec2bcd(uint8_t val) { return ((val / 10) << 4) + (val % 10); }
uint8_t bcd2dec(uint8_t val) { return ((val >> 4) * 10) + (val & 0x0F); }

static void start_wifi_scan(void);
static void wifi_list_item_click_cb(lv_event_t * e);

static void time_sync_notification_cb(struct timeval *tv) {
    ESP_LOGI(TAG, "SNTP Sincronizado com a internet! Gravando no RTC...");
    time_t now;
    struct tm timeinfo;
    time(&now);
    localtime_r(&now, &timeinfo);
    
    if (rtc_handle) {
        uint8_t data[8];
        data[0] = 0x04; 
        data[1] = dec2bcd(timeinfo.tm_sec);
        data[2] = dec2bcd(timeinfo.tm_min);
        data[3] = dec2bcd(timeinfo.tm_hour);
        data[4] = dec2bcd(timeinfo.tm_mday);
        data[5] = dec2bcd(timeinfo.tm_wday);
        data[6] = dec2bcd(timeinfo.tm_mon + 1);    
        data[7] = dec2bcd(timeinfo.tm_year % 100); 
        
        i2c_master_transmit(rtc_handle, data, 8, 1000);
        ESP_LOGI(TAG, "RTC atualizado com sucesso: %02d:%02d:%02d", timeinfo.tm_hour, timeinfo.tm_min, timeinfo.tm_sec);
    }
}

static void initialize_sntp(void) {
    ESP_LOGI(TAG, "Iniciando servico NTP...");
    esp_sntp_setoperatingmode(SNTP_OPMODE_POLL);
    esp_sntp_setservername(0, "pool.ntp.org");
    sntp_set_time_sync_notification_cb(time_sync_notification_cb);
    esp_sntp_init();
    
    setenv("TZ", "<-03>3", 1);
    tzset();
}

static void set_wifi_state(bool state) {
    wifi_started = state;
    if (state) {
        ESP_LOGI(TAG, "Wi-Fi: Ligando antena...");
        esp_wifi_start();
        if (btn_wifi_settings) lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(btn_wifi_settings, lv_color_hex(0x007BFF), 0);
        if (sw_wifi_list) lv_obj_add_state(sw_wifi_list, LV_STATE_CHECKED);
        if (icon_wifi_watchface) lv_obj_set_style_text_color(icon_wifi_watchface, lv_color_white(), 0); 
        if (icon_wifi_slash) lv_obj_add_flag(icon_wifi_slash, LV_OBJ_FLAG_HIDDEN); // Esconde a barra
    } else {
        ESP_LOGI(TAG, "Wi-Fi: Desligando antena...");
        esp_wifi_stop();
        if (btn_wifi_settings) lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(btn_wifi_settings, lv_color_hex(0x333333), 0);
        if (sw_wifi_list) lv_obj_remove_state(sw_wifi_list, LV_STATE_CHECKED);
        if (icon_wifi_watchface) lv_obj_set_style_text_color(icon_wifi_watchface, lv_color_hex(0x333333), 0); 
        if (icon_wifi_slash) lv_obj_remove_flag(icon_wifi_slash, LV_OBJ_FLAG_HIDDEN); // Mostra a barra
    }
}

// Timer para dar tempo da tela renderizar antes do gargalo de hardware
static void delayed_usb_start_cb(lv_timer_t * t) {
    // Passa o controle para o PC apenas agora
    SdUsbManager::get_instance().enable_usb_msc();
    lv_timer_delete(t); // Timer de disparo único
}

// Função para alternar o modo Pendrive
static void set_usb_msc_state(bool state) {
    if (state == usb_msc_started) return; // Evita loop de estado

    usb_msc_started = state;
    
    if (state) {
        ESP_LOGI(TAG, "USB MSC: Solicitando ativação com delay visual...");
        if (btn_usb_settings) lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(btn_usb_settings, lv_color_hex(0x007BFF), 0);
        
        // Vai para a tela estática SEM animação para evitar processamento gráfico (DMA) simultâneo ao USB
        lv_scr_load_anim(scr_usb_msc, LV_SCR_LOAD_ANIM_NONE, 0, 0, false);
        
        // Dá 300ms para o LVGL limpar o buffer e desenhar a tela antes do USB assumir a CPU
        lv_timer_create(delayed_usb_start_cb, 300, NULL);
    } else {
        ESP_LOGI(TAG, "USB MSC: Desligando Modo Pendrive...");
        
        // Retoma o controle para o Relógio (Vai causar o Restart para recuperar o Serial)
        SdUsbManager::get_instance().disable_usb_msc();
    }
}

static void home_btn_timer_cb(lv_timer_t *timer) {
    static uint8_t last_state = 1;
    uint8_t current_state = gpio_get_level(BOOT_BTN_PIN);
    
    // 1. Verificação do Botão Físico
    if (last_state == 1 && current_state == 0) { 
        if (lv_screen_active() != scr_watchface) {
            lv_scr_load_anim(scr_watchface, LV_SCR_LOAD_ANIM_FADE_ON, 200, 0, false);
        }
        // Acorda a tela caso o usuário aperte o botão no escuro
        reset_inactivity_timer(); 
    }
    last_state = current_state;

    // 2. [NOVO] Verificação Global de Toque na Tela
    // Pega o ponteiro do driver de touch ativo no LVGL
    lv_indev_t * indev = lv_indev_get_next(NULL); 
    if (indev) {
        // Se a tela estiver sendo tocada em QUALQUER lugar, reseta o timer
        if (lv_indev_get_state(indev) == LV_INDEV_STATE_PRESSED) {
            reset_inactivity_timer();
        }
    }
}

static void update_time_timer_cb(lv_timer_t *timer) {
    if (!rtc_handle) return;
    uint8_t reg_addr = 0x04; 
    uint8_t data[7] = {0};   
    if (bsp_display_lock(pdMS_TO_TICKS(50))) {
        if (i2c_master_transmit_receive(rtc_handle, &reg_addr, 1, data, 7, 1000) == ESP_OK) {
            uint8_t sec = bcd2dec(data[0] & 0x7F);
            uint8_t min = bcd2dec(data[1] & 0x7F);
            uint8_t hour = bcd2dec(data[2] & 0x3F);
            uint8_t day = bcd2dec(data[3] & 0x3F);
            uint8_t month = bcd2dec(data[5] & 0x1F);
            uint16_t year = 2000 + bcd2dec(data[6]);
            if (time_label) lv_label_set_text_fmt(time_label, "%02d:%02d:%02d", hour, min, sec);
            if (date_label) lv_label_set_text_fmt(date_label, "%02d/%02d/%04d", day, month, year);
        }
        bsp_display_unlock();
    }
}

static void align_pixels_cb(lv_event_t * e) {
    lv_area_t * area = (lv_area_t *)lv_event_get_param(e);
    area->x1 &= ~1; area->y1 &= ~1; area->x2 |= 1; area->y2 |= 1;
}

static void keyboard_ready_cb(lv_event_t * e) {
    const char * pass = lv_textarea_get_text(ta_password);
    strncpy(current_password, pass, sizeof(current_password) - 1);
    
    ESP_LOGI(TAG, "Tentando conectar a %s...", current_ssid);
    lv_label_set_text(label_password_title, "Conectando...");
    
    wifi_config_t wifi_config = {};
    strncpy((char *)wifi_config.sta.ssid, current_ssid, sizeof(wifi_config.sta.ssid) - 1);
    strncpy((char *)wifi_config.sta.password, current_password, sizeof(wifi_config.sta.password) - 1);
    
    esp_wifi_disconnect();
    esp_wifi_set_config(WIFI_IF_STA, &wifi_config);
    esp_wifi_connect();
}

}

            lv_obj_t * txt = lv_list_add_text(list_wifi, "Wi-Fi Desligado");

        }
    }
}

// Timer de atraso para dar tempo do rádio RF ligar antes de escanear
static void delayed_wifi_scan_cb(lv_timer_t * t) {
    start_wifi_scan();
    lv_timer_delete(t); // Timer de disparo único, se destrói após o uso
}

static void wifi_list_switch_cb(lv_event_t * e) {
    lv_obj_t * sw = (lv_obj_t *)lv_event_get_target(e);
    bool is_on = lv_obj_has_state(sw, LV_STATE_CHECKED);
    set_wifi_state(is_on); 
    if (is_on) {
        // Aguarda 500ms para a antena do ESP32 estabilizar antes da varredura
        lv_timer_create(delayed_wifi_scan_cb, 500, NULL);
    } else {
        if (bsp_display_lock(pdMS_TO_TICKS(100))) {
            lv_obj_clean(list_wifi); 
            lv_obj_t * txt = lv_list_add_text(list_wifi, "Wi-Fi Desligado");
            style_list_item(txt);
            bsp_display_unlock();
        }
    }
}

static void wifi_list_item_click_cb(lv_event_t * e) {
    lv_obj_t * btn = (lv_obj_t *)lv_event_get_target(e);
    lv_obj_t * label = lv_obj_get_child(btn, 1); 
    if (label) {
        const char * text = lv_label_get_text(label);
        const char * paren = strrchr(text, '(');
        if (paren != NULL && paren > text) {
            int len = paren - text - 1; 
            if (len > 32) len = 32;
            strncpy(current_ssid, text, len);
            current_ssid[len] = '\0';
        } else {
            strncpy(current_ssid, text, 32);
            current_ssid[32] = '\0';
        }

        ESP_LOGI(TAG, "Rede selecionada: %s", current_ssid);
        
        // Verifica se a rede já está salva no NVS
        wifi_config_t saved_config;
        esp_wifi_get_config(WIFI_IF_STA, &saved_config);

        char title_buf[64];
        if (strcmp((char*)saved_config.sta.ssid, current_ssid) == 0 && strlen((char*)saved_config.sta.password) > 0) {
            ESP_LOGI(TAG, "Rede ja salva. Preenchendo teclado e auto-conectando.");
            snprintf(title_buf, sizeof(title_buf), "Conectando: %s", current_ssid);
            lv_label_set_text(label_password_title, title_buf);
            
            // Preenche o teclado com a senha antiga (útil se a pessoa só quiser ver ou editar)
            lv_textarea_set_text(ta_password, (char*)saved_config.sta.password);
            
            // Tenta conectar logo de cara
            esp_wifi_connect();
        } else {
            snprintf(title_buf, sizeof(title_buf), "Senha: %s", current_ssid);
            lv_label_set_text(label_password_title, title_buf);
            lv_textarea_set_text(ta_password, ""); 
        }

        lv_scr_load_anim(scr_password, LV_SCR_LOAD_ANIM_MOVE_LEFT, 300, 0, false);
    }
}

static void wifi_event_handler(void* arg, esp_event_base_t event_base, int32_t event_id, void* event_data) 
{
    // [NOVO] Auto-conectar ao ligar a antena
    if (event_base == WIFI_EVENT && event_id == WIFI_EVENT_STA_START) {
        ESP_LOGI(TAG, "Wi-Fi Iniciado. Tentando auto-conectar na rede salva...");
        esp_wifi_connect();
    }
    
    else if (event_base == WIFI_EVENT && event_id == WIFI_EVENT_SCAN_DONE) {
        uint16_t ap_count = 0;
        esp_wifi_scan_get_ap_num(&ap_count);
        
        if (ap_count == 0) {
            if (bsp_display_lock(pdMS_TO_TICKS(100))) {
                lv_obj_clean(list_wifi); 
                lv_obj_t * txt = lv_list_add_text(list_wifi, "Nenhuma rede encontrada");
                style_list_item(txt);
                bsp_display_unlock();
            }
            return;
        }

        if (ap_count > 15) ap_count = 15;
        wifi_ap_record_t *ap_info = (wifi_ap_record_t *)malloc(sizeof(wifi_ap_record_t) * ap_count);
        if (ap_info == NULL) return;

        if (esp_wifi_scan_get_ap_records(&ap_count, ap_info) == ESP_OK) {
            if (bsp_display_lock(pdMS_TO_TICKS(100))) {
                lv_obj_clean(list_wifi); 
                for (int i = 0; i < ap_count; i++) {
                    char ssid_str[33];
                    strncpy(ssid_str, (char *)ap_info[i].ssid, 32);
                    ssid_str[32] = '\0'; // <-- CORREÇÃO AQUI
                    if (strlen(ssid_str) == 0) continue;

                    char list_item_text[64];
                    snprintf(list_item_text, sizeof(list_item_text), "%s (%d dBm)", ssid_str, ap_info[i].rssi);

                    lv_obj_t * btn = lv_list_add_button(list_wifi, LV_SYMBOL_WIFI, list_item_text);
                    style_list_item(btn); 
                    lv_obj_add_event_cb(btn, wifi_list_item_click_cb, LV_EVENT_CLICKED, NULL);
                }
                bsp_display_unlock();
            }
        }
        free(ap_info);
    }
    
    else if (event_base == WIFI_EVENT && event_id == WIFI_EVENT_STA_DISCONNECTED) {
        ESP_LOGW(TAG, "Desconectado do Wi-Fi.");
        
        if (wifi_started && icon_wifi_watchface) {
            if (bsp_display_lock(pdMS_TO_TICKS(100))) {
                lv_obj_set_style_text_color(icon_wifi_watchface, lv_color_white(), 0);
                bsp_display_unlock();
            }
        }

        if (lv_screen_active() == scr_password) {
            if (bsp_display_lock(pdMS_TO_TICKS(100))) {
                lv_label_set_text(label_password_title, "Falha! Senha Incorreta?");
                bsp_display_unlock();
            }
        }
    }
    
    else if (event_base == IP_EVENT && event_id == IP_EVENT_STA_GOT_IP) {
        ip_event_got_ip_t* event = (ip_event_got_ip_t*) event_data;
        ESP_LOGI(TAG, "Conectado! IP: " IPSTR, IP2STR(&event->ip_info.ip));
        
        // Lê do chip de Wi-Fi o nome da rede que conectamos e salva na global
        wifi_ap_record_t ap_info;
        if (esp_wifi_sta_get_ap_info(&ap_info) == ESP_OK) {
            strncpy(current_ssid, (char *)ap_info.ssid, sizeof(current_ssid) - 1);
            current_ssid[sizeof(current_ssid) - 1] = '\0';
        }

        if (icon_wifi_watchface) {
            if (bsp_display_lock(pdMS_TO_TICKS(100))) {
                lv_obj_set_style_text_color(icon_wifi_watchface, lv_color_hex(0x00FF00), 0);
                bsp_display_unlock();
            }
        }

        static bool sntp_inited = false;
        if (!sntp_inited) {
            initialize_sntp();
            sntp_inited = true;
        }
        
        if (lv_screen_active() == scr_password) {
            if (bsp_display_lock(pdMS_TO_TICKS(100))) {
                lv_label_set_text(label_password_title, "Conectado!");
                lv_scr_load_anim(scr_settings, LV_SCR_LOAD_ANIM_MOVE_RIGHT, 400, 1000, false);
                bsp_display_unlock();
            }
        }
    }
}

static void start_wifi_scan(void) {
    if (bsp_display_lock(pdMS_TO_TICKS(100))) {
        lv_obj_clean(list_wifi); 
        lv_obj_t * txt = lv_list_add_text(list_wifi, "Escaneando...");
        style_list_item(txt);
        bsp_display_unlock();
    }
    wifi_scan_config_t scan_config = {};
    scan_config.show_hidden = false;
    scan_config.scan_type = WIFI_SCAN_TYPE_ACTIVE;
    scan_config.scan_time.active.min = 100;
    scan_config.scan_time.active.max = 300;
    esp_wifi_scan_start(&scan_config, false);
}

static void init_wifi_basic(void) {
    esp_err_t ret = nvs_flash_init();
    if (ret == ESP_ERR_NVS_NO_FREE_PAGES || ret == ESP_ERR_NVS_NEW_VERSION_FOUND) {
      ESP_ERROR_CHECK(nvs_flash_erase());
      ret = nvs_flash_init();
    }
    ESP_ERROR_CHECK(ret);
    ESP_ERROR_CHECK(esp_netif_init());
    ESP_ERROR_CHECK(esp_event_loop_create_default());
    esp_netif_create_default_wifi_sta();
    wifi_init_config_t cfg = WIFI_INIT_CONFIG_DEFAULT();
    ESP_ERROR_CHECK(esp_wifi_init(&cfg));
    
    esp_wifi_set_storage(WIFI_STORAGE_FLASH); 
    
    ESP_ERROR_CHECK(esp_wifi_set_mode(WIFI_MODE_STA));

    ESP_ERROR_CHECK(esp_event_handler_instance_register(WIFI_EVENT, ESP_EVENT_ANY_ID, &wifi_event_handler, NULL, NULL));
    ESP_ERROR_CHECK(esp_event_handler_instance_register(IP_EVENT, IP_EVENT_STA_GOT_IP, &wifi_event_handler, NULL, NULL));
}

static void watchface_gesture_cb(lv_event_t * e) {
    if (!system_ready || !anim_finished) return;

    lv_indev_t * indev = lv_indev_active();
    if(indev == NULL) return;
    lv_dir_t dir = lv_indev_get_gesture_dir(indev);
    if(dir == LV_DIR_BOTTOM) lv_scr_load_anim(scr_settings, LV_SCR_LOAD_ANIM_MOVE_BOTTOM, 300, 0, false);
    else if(dir == LV_DIR_LEFT) lv_scr_load_anim(scr_apps, LV_SCR_LOAD_ANIM_MOVE_LEFT, 300, 0, false);
}

static void settings_gesture_cb(lv_event_t * e) {
    lv_indev_t * indev = lv_indev_active();
    if(indev == NULL) return;
    lv_dir_t dir = lv_indev_get_gesture_dir(indev);
    if(dir == LV_DIR_TOP) lv_scr_load_anim(scr_watchface, LV_SCR_LOAD_ANIM_MOVE_TOP, 300, 0, false);
    else if(dir == LV_DIR_RIGHT && touch_start_x < 20) lv_scr_load_anim(scr_watchface, LV_SCR_LOAD_ANIM_MOVE_RIGHT, 300, 0, false);
}

static void apps_gesture_cb(lv_event_t * e) {
    lv_indev_t * indev = lv_indev_active();
    if(indev != NULL && lv_indev_get_gesture_dir(indev) == LV_DIR_RIGHT) {
        lv_scr_load_anim(scr_watchface, LV_SCR_LOAD_ANIM_MOVE_RIGHT, 300, 0, false);
    }
}

static void wifi_list_gesture_cb(lv_event_t * e) {
    lv_indev_t * indev = lv_indev_active();
    if(indev == NULL) return;
    lv_dir_t dir = lv_indev_get_gesture_dir(indev);
    if(dir == LV_DIR_RIGHT && touch_start_x < 20) {
        lv_scr_load_anim(scr_settings, LV_SCR_LOAD_ANIM_MOVE_RIGHT, 300, 0, false);
    }
}

static void password_gesture_cb(lv_event_t * e) {
    lv_indev_t * indev = lv_indev_active();
    if(indev == NULL) return;
    lv_dir_t dir = lv_indev_get_gesture_dir(indev);
    if(dir == LV_DIR_RIGHT && touch_start_x < 20) {
        lv_scr_load_anim(scr_wifi_list, LV_SCR_LOAD_ANIM_MOVE_RIGHT, 300, 0, false);
    }
}
