    lv_dir_t dir = lv_indev_get_gesture_dir(lv_indev_active());
    if(dir == LV_DIR_RIGHT && touch_start_x < 20) {
        app_nettools_stop_tasks(); 
        lv_scr_load_anim(scr_menu_nettools, LV_SCR_LOAD_ANIM_MOVE_RIGHT, 300, 0, false);
    }
}

// =========================================================
// LÓGICA DO BEACON ANALYZER (BLE)
// =========================================================

static int beacon_gap_event_cb(struct ble_gap_event *event, void *arg) {
    if (event->type == BLE_GAP_EVENT_DISC) {
        
        // 1. TELA DE RASTREIO (SE ESTAMOS CAÇANDO UM BEACON ESPECÍFICO)
        if (is_tracking_beacon) {
            if (memcmp(tracking_beacon_addr.val, event->disc.addr.val, 6) == 0) {
                int8_t rssi = event->disc.rssi;
                float distance = pow(10.0, (-59.0 - rssi) / 25.0); 
                
                int dist_int = (int)distance;
                int dist_dec = (int)(distance * 10) % 10;

                if (bsp_display_lock(pdMS_TO_TICKS(50))) {
                    lv_label_set_text_fmt(lbl_beacon_track_rssi, "Sinal: %d dBm", rssi);
                    lv_label_set_text_fmt(lbl_beacon_track_dist, "Distancia: %d.%d m", dist_int, dist_dec);
                    bsp_display_unlock();
                }
            }
            return 0; // Ignora a lista e volta pra varredura
        }

        // 2. LISTA PRINCIPAL
        struct ble_hs_adv_fields fields;
        ble_hs_adv_parse_fields(&fields, event->disc.data, event->disc.length_data);
        
        char beacon_type[32] = "";
        bool is_beacon = false;

        if (fields.mfg_data_len >= 3 && fields.mfg_data[0] == 0x4C && fields.mfg_data[1] == 0x00) {
            if (fields.mfg_data[2] == 0x02 && fields.mfg_data_len >= 23) {
                strcpy(beacon_type, "Apple iBeacon");
                is_beacon = true;
            } 
            else if (fields.mfg_data[2] == 0x12) {
                strcpy(beacon_type, "Apple AirTag");
                is_beacon = true;
            }
        }
        
        if (!is_beacon && fields.num_uuids16 > 0) {
            for (int i = 0; i < fields.num_uuids16; i++) {
                if (fields.uuids16[i].value == 0xFEAA) {
                    strcpy(beacon_type, "Google Eddystone");
                    is_beacon = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        if (!is_beacon) return 0; 

        // Atualização da lista
        for (int i = 0; i < num_beacons; i++) {
            if (memcmp(discovered_beacons[i].addr.val, event->disc.addr.val, 6) == 0) {
                discovered_beacons[i].last_rssi = event->disc.rssi;
                
                if (discovered_beacons[i].lbl_ptr != NULL) {
                    if (bsp_display_lock(pdMS_TO_TICKS(15))) {
                        if (discovered_beacons[i].lbl_ptr != NULL) {
                            lv_label_set_text_fmt(discovered_beacons[i].lbl_ptr, "%s\nMAC: %02X:%02X:%02X:%02X:%02X:%02X | %d dBm",
                                discovered_beacons[i].type,
                                discovered_beacons[i].addr.val[5], discovered_beacons[i].addr.val[4], discovered_beacons[i].addr.val[3],
                                discovered_beacons[i].addr.val[2], discovered_beacons[i].addr.val[1], discovered_beacons[i].addr.val[0],
                                discovered_beacons[i].last_rssi);
                        }
                        bsp_display_unlock();
                    }
                }
                return 0; 
            }
        }
        
        // NOVO BEACON DETECTADO!
        if (num_beacons < MAX_BEACONS) {
            discovered_beacons[num_beacons].addr = event->disc.addr;
            strcpy(discovered_beacons[num_beacons].type, beacon_type);
            discovered_beacons[num_beacons].last_rssi = event->disc.rssi;
            
            int current_idx = num_beacons;
            num_beacons++;
            
            char mac_str[18];
            snprintf(mac_str, sizeof(mac_str), "%02X:%02X:%02X:%02X:%02X:%02X",
                     event->disc.addr.val[5], event->disc.addr.val[4], event->disc.addr.val[3],
                     event->disc.addr.val[2], event->disc.addr.val[1], event->disc.addr.val[0]);
            
            if (bsp_display_lock(pdMS_TO_TICKS(50))) {
                lv_obj_t * btn = lv_list_add_button(list_beacons, LV_SYMBOL_GPS, "");
                style_list_item(btn);
                
                lv_obj_t * lbl = lv_obj_get_child(btn, 1);
                if(lbl) {
                    lv_obj_set_style_text_font(lbl, &lv_font_montserrat_14, 0);
                    if (strstr(beacon_type, "Apple") != NULL) lv_obj_set_style_text_color(lbl, lv_color_hex(0xFF9999), 0);
                    if (strstr(beacon_type, "Google") != NULL) lv_obj_set_style_text_color(lbl, lv_color_hex(0x99FF99), 0);
                    
                    lv_label_set_text_fmt(lbl, "%s\nMAC: %s | %d dBm", beacon_type, mac_str, event->disc.rssi);
                    discovered_beacons[current_idx].lbl_ptr = lbl; 
                } else {
                    discovered_beacons[current_idx].lbl_ptr = NULL;
                }
                
                // [NOVO] Evento de CLIQUE para entrar no radar!
                lv_obj_add_event_cb(btn, [](lv_event_t * e) {
                    int idx = (int)(uintptr_t)lv_event_get_user_data(e);
                    tracking_beacon_addr = discovered_beacons[idx].addr;
                    is_tracking_beacon = true; 

                    char trk_mac[18];
                    snprintf(trk_mac, sizeof(trk_mac), "%02X:%02X:%02X:%02X:%02X:%02X",
                             tracking_beacon_addr.val[5], tracking_beacon_addr.val[4], tracking_beacon_addr.val[3],
                             tracking_beacon_addr.val[2], tracking_beacon_addr.val[1], tracking_beacon_addr.val[0]);

                    if (bsp_display_lock(pdMS_TO_TICKS(50))) {
                        lv_label_set_text(lbl_beacon_track_type, discovered_beacons[idx].type);
                        
                        // Herda a cor do fabricante
                        if (strstr(discovered_beacons[idx].type, "Apple") != NULL) lv_obj_set_style_text_color(lbl_beacon_track_type, lv_color_hex(0xFF9999), 0);
                        else if (strstr(discovered_beacons[idx].type, "Google") != NULL) lv_obj_set_style_text_color(lbl_beacon_track_type, lv_color_hex(0x99FF99), 0);
                        else lv_obj_set_style_text_color(lbl_beacon_track_type, lv_color_hex(0x00FF00), 0);

                        lv_label_set_text_fmt(lbl_beacon_track_mac, "MAC: %s", trk_mac);
                        lv_label_set_text_fmt(lbl_beacon_track_rssi, "Sinal: %d dBm", discovered_beacons[idx].last_rssi);
                        lv_label_set_text_fmt(lbl_beacon_track_dist, "Distancia: Calculando...");
                        
                        lv_scr_load_anim(scr_beacon_track, LV_SCR_LOAD_ANIM_MOVE_LEFT, 300, 0, false);
                        bsp_display_unlock();
                    }
                }, LV_EVENT_CLICKED, (void*)(uintptr_t)current_idx); 

                bsp_display_unlock();
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

static void start_beacon_action(void) {
    if (!ble_started) {
        if (bsp_display_lock(0)) {
            lv_label_set_text(lbl_beacon_status, "Ative o BLE nas\nConfiguracoes!");
            bsp_display_unlock();
        }
        return;
    }

    if (is_scanning_beacon) {
        ble_gap_disc_cancel();
        is_scanning_beacon = false;
        
        if (bsp_display_lock(0)) {
            lv_obj_t * lbl = lv_obj_get_child(btn_start_beacon, 0);
            if (lbl) lv_label_set_text(lbl, "SCAN");
            lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(btn_start_beacon, lv_color_hex(0x007BFF), 0);
            lv_label_set_text(lbl_beacon_status, "Busca parada.");
            bsp_display_unlock();
        }
    } else {
        if (bsp_display_lock(0)) {
            is_tracking_beacon = false;
            num_beacons = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_BEACONS; i++) discovered_beacons[i].lbl_ptr = NULL; 

            lv_obj_clean(list_beacons);
            lv_label_set_text(lbl_beacon_status, "Rastreando Beacons...");
            lv_obj_t * lbl = lv_obj_get_child(btn_start_beacon, 0);
            if (lbl) lv_label_set_text(lbl, "PARAR");
            lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(btn_start_beacon, lv_color_hex(0xFF3333), 0);
            bsp_display_unlock();
        }
        
        is_scanning_beacon = true;
        
        struct ble_gap_disc_params disc_params;
        memset(&disc_params, 0, sizeof(disc_params));
        disc_params.filter_duplicates = 0; // Precisamos do RSSI em tempo real!
        disc_params.passive = 1; // [IMPORTANTE]: O Beacons nunca respondem nomes (Active Scan). Apenas passivo funciona bem.
        disc_params.itvl = 0;
        disc_params.window = 0;
        
        int rc = ble_gap_disc(BLE_OWN_ADDR_PUBLIC, BLE_HS_FOREVER, &disc_params, beacon_gap_event_cb, NULL);
        if (rc != 0) {
            is_scanning_beacon = false;
            if (bsp_display_lock(0)) {
                lv_obj_t * lbl = lv_obj_get_child(btn_start_beacon, 0);
                if (lbl) lv_label_set_text(lbl, "SCAN");
                lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(btn_start_beacon, lv_color_hex(0x007BFF), 0);
                lv_label_set_text(lbl_beacon_status, "Falha no Radio.");
                bsp_display_unlock();
            }
        }
    }
}

    lv_dir_t dir = lv_indev_get_gesture_dir(lv_indev_active());
    if(dir == LV_DIR_RIGHT && touch_start_x < 20) {

    }

        lv_scr_load_anim(scr_beacon, LV_SCR_LOAD_ANIM_MOVE_RIGHT, 300, 0, false);
    }
}

    lv_obj_align(btn_start_gatt, LV_ALIGN_TOP_RIGHT, -30, 15);
    lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(btn_start_gatt, lv_color_hex(0x007BFF), 0);
    lv_obj_t * btn_gatt_lbl = lv_label_create(btn_start_gatt);
    lv_label_set_text(btn_gatt_lbl, "SCAN");
    lv_obj_center(btn_gatt_lbl);
